program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let* ((palette (take (filter (lambda (v) (not (= v 0))) (row g 0)) 2))
         (seed (first (find-color g 9))))
    (define dirs (list (list -1 0) (list 1 0) (list 0 -1) (list 0 1)))
    (define (draw-dir out d)
      (let walk ([acc out]
                 [r (+ (first seed) (first d))]
                 [c (+ (second seed) (second d))]
                 [step 0])
        (if (in-bounds? r c (rows g) (cols g))
            (let ((next (if (= (at acc r c) 0)
                            (set-cell acc r c (nth palette (modulo step (length palette))))
                            acc)))
              (walk next (+ r (first d)) (+ c (second d)) (+ step 1)))
            acc)))
    (for/fold ([out g]) ([d (in-list dirs)])
      (draw-dir out d))))
